verdict.rationale: There is a dedicated call-pricing doc page and mentions that BYOK/connected providers aren't charged (bolna-docs-19, bolna-docs-10), indicating some usage-based pricing structure exists, but no evidence pack item actually quotes a per-minute rate, tiered pricing table, or a cost calculator a founder could use to estimate cost per call. Missing for 10: explicit per-minute/usage rate figures, a pricing calculator or worked cost example, and independent confirmation that published rates are accurate.
